Docs.summary: Represents a single measurement from a Downlink Time Difference of Arrival (DL-TDoA) ranging session.

remarks.para: Represents a single measurement from a Downlink Time Difference of Arrival (DL-TDoA) ranging session.
For more details, refer to the FiRa 2.0 and FiRa 4.0 specification.
Portions of this page are modifications based on work created and shared by the Android Open Source Project and used according to terms described in the Creative Commons 2.5 Attribution License.

Docs.summary: Returns a list of active ranging round indexes.
Docs.value: The list of active ranging round indexes. An empty list is returned if active ranging round indexes are not present.

remarks.para: Returns a list of active ranging round indexes.
These are the rounds in which the DT-Anchor associated with this measurement result is present.
Portions of this page are modifications based on work created and shared by the Android Open Source Project and used according to terms described in the Creative Commons 2.5 Attribution License.

Docs.summary: Returns the Clock Frequency Offset (CFO) of a Responder DT-Anchor.
Docs.value: The Anchor CFO as a float, or Float.NaN if not available.

remarks.para: Returns the Clock Frequency Offset (CFO) of a Responder DT-Anchor.
This offset is relative to the Initiator DT-Anchor of the ranging round, in ppm units.
Portions of this page are modifications based on work created and shared by the Android Open Source Project and used according to terms described in the Creative Commons 2.5 Attribution License.

Docs.summary: Returns the Angle of Arrival (AoA) azimuth in degrees.
Docs.value: The AoA azimuth value in degrees, or Float.NaN if not available.

remarks.para: Returns the Angle of Arrival (AoA) azimuth in degrees.
This value ranges from -180 to 180 degrees. If the value is not available, it returns Float.NaN.
Portions of this page are modifications based on work created and shared by the Android Open Source Project and used according to terms described in the Creative Commons 2.5 Attribution License.

Docs.summary: Returns the Figure of Merit (FoM) of the AoA azimuth.
Docs.value: The AoA azimuth FoM value in percentage, or 0 if not available.

remarks.para: Returns the Figure of Merit (FoM) of the AoA azimuth.
This value ranges from 0 to 100. If the value is not available, it returns 0.
Portions of this page are modifications based on work created and shared by the Android Open Source Project and used according to terms described in the Creative Commons 2.5 Attribution License.

Docs.summary: Returns the Angle of Arrival (AoA) elevation in degrees.
Docs.value: The AoA elevation value in degrees, or Float.NaN if not available.

remarks.para: Returns the Angle of Arrival (AoA) elevation in degrees.
This value ranges from -90 to 90 degrees. If the value is not available, it returns Float.NaN.
Portions of this page are modifications based on work created and shared by the Android Open Source Project and used according to terms described in the Creative Commons 2.5 Attribution License.

Docs.summary: Returns the Figure of Merit (FoM) of the AoA elevation.

This value ranges from 0 to 100. If the value is not available, it returns 0.
Portions of this page are modifications based on work created and shared by the Android Open Source Project and used according to terms described in the Creative Commons 2.5 Attribution License.

Docs.summary: Returns the block index of the current ranging block.
Docs.value: The block index as an integer.

remarks.para: Returns the block index of the current ranging block.
This identifies the specific ranging block during which the measurement occurred.

This offset is relative to the DT-Anchor that sent the message, in ppm units.

Docs.summary: Returns true if Supercluster ID is present.
Docs.value: true if Supercluster ID is present, false otherwise.

remarks.para: Returns true if Supercluster ID is present.
If this value is available, Supercluster common timebase is valid for Initiator DT-Anchors using the same Supercluster ID.
Portions of this page are modifications based on work created and shared by the Android Open Source Project and used according to terms described in the Creative Commons 2.5 Attribution License.

Docs.summary: Returns the time difference measured by the Initiator DT-Anchor.
Docs.value: The Initiator Reply Time as a long.

remarks.para: Returns the time difference measured by the Initiator DT-Anchor.

It's between the RX timestamp of a Responder's DTM and the TX timestamp of the Final DTM, in Ranging Ticks (~15.65 ps). If the ranging method SS-TWR is used between DT-Anchors, then there is no Final DTM at all and this value is 0.
Portions of this page are modifications based on work created and shared by the Android Open Source Project and used according to terms described in the Creative Commons 2.5 Attribution License.

Docs.summary: Returns the Time of Flight (ToF) between the Responder and Initiator DT-Anchors.
Docs.value: The Initiator-Responder ToF as an integer.

remarks.para: Returns the Time of Flight (ToF) between the Responder and Initiator DT-Anchors.
This is measured by the Responder DT-Anchor, in Ranging Ticks (~15.65 ps). This field is only valid for the Response DTM. For Poll DTM and Final DTM, this value is 0.
Portions of this page are modifications based on work created and shared by the Android Open Source Project and used according to terms described in the Creative Commons 2.5 Attribution License.

Docs.summary: Returns true if TX timestamp is based on a common time base.
Docs.value: true if the TX timestamp is in the common time base, false otherwise.

remarks.para: Returns true if TX timestamp is based on a common time base.
This value is derived from bit 0 of the MessageControl field. If TX timestamp is not based on a common time base, it is based on the local time base and cannot be used for localization.
Portions of this page are modifications based on work created and shared by the Android Open Source Project and used according to terms described in the Creative Commons 2.5 Attribution License.
